name: Cinderella to 100 Oku-doru no Ouji-sama
original_name: シンデレラと100億ドルの王子様
source:
You've been selected to be the leading lady on Cinderella TV, a world-famous reality show! This might just be the chance you need to launch your career as a fashion designer and pull your family out of debt.

While on the show, you'll be staying in a lavish mansion in Hollywood and rubbing elbows with everyone from famous authors to wayward princes, and all the while several of the world's most eligible bachelors will be vying for the key to your heart!

When brewing trouble threatens to get you kicked off the show, will you have the wherewithal to hold onto to your love and fight for your happy ending?

[from [url=http://www.cinderellatv.com/]Official website[/url]]
translation:
你被選為世界知名實境節目「Cinderella TV」的女主角！這或許正是你開啟服裝設計師生涯、幫助家人擺脫債務的機會。

參加節目期間，你將住進好萊塢的一座豪華宅邸，與知名作家、任性王子等各界人物交往。與此同時，幾位世界上最炙手可熱的單身男子，也將爭相贏得你的芳心！

當醞釀中的風波讓你面臨被節目淘汰的危險時，你能否守住愛情，為自己的幸福結局奮力一搏？

[來源：[url=http://www.cinderellatv.com/]官方網站[/url]]
